topography.project_purpose: Yield. Structurally: 30 project-authored contract(s) across 1 chain(s); 4 ERC20 tokens, 1 ERC721 NFT; role-gated via AccessControl; upgradeable via ERC1967/UUPS proxies; built on openzeppelin.
topography.relationship_narrative: The protocol comprises 7 functional families. Its contracts share 3 common project-authored base contract(s) (vaultcontroller, whitelist, rewardsdistributionrecipient). Dominant framework: openzeppelin.
